title: Design System: แผนที่เที่ยวเกาะเกร็ด

display.purpose: Page H1 only — one per screen.

title.purpose: Section headers, place names, route names.

shadows.name: pin-rest
shadows.purpose: Default pin lift off the map art.

shadows.name: pin-selected
shadows.purpose: Selected pin — Kiln-Clay-tinted glow, not generic gray.

shadows.name: popup
shadows.purpose: Place-detail card floating over the map.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for every transition in the system (ease-out-expo; no bounce/elastic).

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover states, category pill toggle, search-field focus.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Popup open, route-card active-state transition, non-matching pins fading out.

motion.name: duration-route-draw
motion.purpose: Route polyline stroke-dashoffset animation when a route is selected.

motion.name: stagger-step
motion.purpose: Per-item delay when route pins or itinerary cards reveal in visiting order — the delay itself carries the sequence information.

components.name: Category Pill
components.description: Sidebar category filter toggle. Default and active states shown together.
components.css: .ds-pill { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:#FFFFFF; color:#334155; border:1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius:8px; padding:8px 12px; font:500 14px 'Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-pill:hover { background:#F8FAFC; } .ds-pill--active { background:#2563EB; color:#FFFFFF; border-color:transparent; }

components.name: Route Card
components.description: Route picker list item. Active state uses Kiln Clay tint + border, not the old same-as-canvas gray.
components.css: .ds-route-card { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; width:100%; text-align:left; background:#FFFFFF; border:1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius:8px; padding:12px; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-route-card:hover { background:#F8FAFC; } .ds-route-card--active { background:rgba(181,80,46,0.08); border-color:#B5502E; } .ds-route-dot { width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:9999px; background:#B5502E; flex-shrink:0; } .ds-route-copy strong { display:block; font:600 14px 'Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif; color:#0F172A; } .ds-route-copy small { display:block; font:500 12px 'Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif; color:#334155; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Place-name search field. Focus is a border-weight change, not a glow ring (flat system).
components.html: 🔍
components.css: .ds-search { position:relative; } .ds-search-icon { position:absolute; left:12px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); color:#334155; pointer-events:none; } .ds-search-input { width:100%; background:#FFFFFF; border:1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius:8px; padding:8px 12px 8px 36px; font:400 14px 'Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif; color:#0F172A; outline:none; transition:border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-search-input:focus { border-color:#0F172A; } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color:#334155; }

components.name: Map Pin
components.description: Signature component. Default (category-colored), selected (Kiln-Clay glow, larger), and route-numbered (stop order) states.
components.css: .ds-pin { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:28px; height:28px; border-radius:9999px; border:2px solid #FFFFFF; color:#FFFFFF; font:700 12px 'Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.15); transition:transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-pin:hover { transform:scale(1.1); } .ds-pin--selected { width:36px; height:36px; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(181,80,46,0.35); } .ds-pin--route { width:28px; height:28px; }

components.name: Popup Card
components.description: Place-detail card that surfaces from the map on pin tap. Enters with translate+fade; instant with reduced motion.
components.html:
🛕 วัดและศาสนสถานวัดปรมัยยิกาวาส

วัดที่มีชื่อเสียงที่สุดของเกาะเกร็ด จุดถ่ายภาพยอดนิยมริมแม่น้ำ
components.css: .ds-popup { position:relative; background:#FFFFFF; border-radius:12px; padding:16px; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(15,23,42,0.16); max-width:320px; animation:ds-popup-in 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } @keyframes ds-popup-in { from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(8px); } to { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-popup { animation:none; } } .ds-popup-close { position:absolute; top:8px; right:8px; width:24px; height:24px; border:none; background:transparent; color:#334155; border-radius:9999px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-popup-close:hover { background:#F8FAFC; } .ds-popup-tag { display:inline-block; background:#D97706; color:#0F172A; font:500 12px 'Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:9999px; margin-bottom:8px; } .ds-popup-title { display:block; font:600 16px 'Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif; color:#0F172A; } .ds-popup-body { margin-top:8px; font:400 14px 'Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif; color:#334155; line-height:1.6; }

narrative.overview: Koh Kret exists because a 300-year-old canal cut through a bend of the Chao Phraya, turning a peninsula into an island. The map echoes that: a calm, near-white canvas is the water, a single warm clay accent marks whatever the visitor is doing right now, and route lines are the only thing on screen allowed to feel like current — they draw themselves on, in the order a boat would actually take them. This system explicitly rejects the dark-navy smart-city-dashboard direction (considered and dropped: reads as a tech product, not a place, and loses contrast in outdoor sun) and the cluttered-badge-everywhere version of the reference mockup.
keyCharacteristics: Near-white, chroma-near-zero canvas; warmth lives only in the Kiln Clay accent
One typeface (Noto Sans Thai), hierarchy from weight, not font-switching
Flat by default; elevation and color both reserved for "this is active right now"
Motion narrates the trip (a route drawing itself on, stops appearing in visiting order), never decorates

rules.name: The Cool Canvas Rule
rules.body: The page background is chroma-near-zero off-white, full stop. Warmth comes from the Kiln Clay accent being used more, never from tinting the canvas.

rules.name: The Legible-Pin Rule
rules.body: Text/icon color on any category or route swatch is chosen by that swatch's own contrast against white, not hardcoded. Five of eight in-use swatches fail 4.5:1 with white and need Ink text instead.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: No second typeface is introduced for brand feel. Push weight or size within Noto Sans Thai before reaching for another font.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadow exists only on pins and the popup — things genuinely overlaying the map. Sidebar cards, the route list, and the itinerary strip stay flat with a hairline border instead.

dos: Do keep the canvas a true near-white (#F8FAFC) — warmth comes only from Kiln Clay, never from tinting the background toward cream or sand.
Do reserve Kiln Clay for "this is selected / active / the primary path" — the active route card, the selected pin's glow, any future primary button.
Do pick pin/pill text color per-swatch by contrast (the Legible-Pin Rule) — Ink text on Temple Gold, Kiln Fire, Banana Leaf, Boat Landing, and Clay Trail; white text everywhere else.
Do animate route selection as information: the line draws itself on, stops appear in visiting order. Motion should always answer "what changed for my trip," never run just because a state changed.
Do keep the system to one typeface and six category hues total — adding a seventh category or a second accent color needs a reason, not just more content to sort.
donts: Don't use gradient text, decorative glassmorphism, or a colored side-stripe border anywhere in this system.
Don't move the canvas toward dark navy or any tech-dashboard palette — considered for this project and explicitly rejected.
Don't default every section to an identical icon-plus-heading card. The route cards, the popup, and the itinerary strip are three different shapes on purpose.
Don't assume white text is safe on a category or route color without checking — five of the eight in-use swatches fail at white and need Ink text instead.
Don't add a tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow above sections, or numbered 01/02/03 markers — neither pattern exists in this system and neither should get added by reflex.
Don't let the category or route count grow past what fits in one unscrolled sidebar glance — the original brief was "ไม่รกเกินไป" (not cluttered); that's a hard ceiling, not a suggestion.
